name: Zerno
tagline: Mittwochs rösten wir. Hier, im Raum. · По средам жарим. Прямо здесь, в зале.

positioning.difference: Roasts every Wednesday in the guest room itself — 14 seats, neighbours see, smell and hear their coffee being made and take the beans home the same week.
is: a working room with a log book

do: numbers instead of adjectives (batch, °C, minutes, date)
German 'du/ihr' Kiez register; Russian «вы», warm not stiff
same structure in DE and RU
dont: artisan / passion / Erlebnis / experience / крафтовый / атмосферный
examples: Mittwochs rösten wir. Hier, im Raum.
По средам жарим. Прямо здесь, в зале.
Charge 47 — geröstet am Mittwoch, getrunken bis Sonntag.

color.usage: 70% kraft, 20% ink, 7% roast brown, 3% ember (ember = action or 'Wednesday/среда' only)

rules: The roast curve draws once on scroll; nothing loops

stamp.note: rectangular ink border, mono uppercase label — 'MITTWOCH · СРЕДА'

imagery.light: warm tungsten inside mixed with grey Berlin daylight from the street window
imagery.grade: warm browns, matte, lifted blacks, visible film grain, no teal-orange
imagery.framing: close on hands, drum, cooling tray, steam; neighbours candid, not posed
imagery.subjects: the roaster in the guest room, beans cooling, kraft bags with handwritten batch numbers, regulars at the 14 seats

film.pace: slow, 3–5s shots, Wednesday morning in real time
film.camera: handheld but calm, or locked-off on the drum; no whip pans
film.cuts: straight cuts on sound (first crack, tray opening)
film.sound: drum rumble, first crack, cups, street through the door; no music bed or sparse
film.type_in_motion: Alegreya headlines + Plex Mono data, fades only, 520ms
